title: Indian Masala Egg Bhurji (Spiced Scrambled Eggs)
ingredients: 1 green or red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
2 large tomatoes, deseeded and finely chopped
4 chapatis (or gluten-free alternative), lightly toasted, to serve
instructions: Prep all ingredients for Indian Masala Egg Bhurji (Spiced Scrambled Eggs): 1 tbsp butter, 1 small red onion, finely chopped, 1 green or red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped, 2 garlic cloves, crushed.

Cook and assemble according to the doc method: 1 tbsp butter 1 small red onion, finely chopped 1 green or red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped 2 garlic cloves, crushed ¼ tsp ground cumin ¼ tsp garam masala good pinch of turmeric 2 large tomatoes, deseeded and finely chopped 7 eggs, beaten small pack coriander, roughly chopped 4 chapatis (or gluten-free alternative), lightly toasted, to serve.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and acidity to taste and serve hot.
